name: delete_files
title: Delete files and folders
description: Delete explicitly authorized absolute native files and empty directories without operation records. Normally uses Windows Recycle Bin or macOS Trash. An ordinary file with a Windows reserved final name is permanently deleted after identity checks without using the bin; dry-run reports would_permanently_delete. If Windows reports that an ordinary item is too large for the bin and its original identity is confirmed, Prunlet attempts permanent deletion. Prunlet may also permanently delete a normal item only when Windows reports the bin unavailable, the effective-user per-volume immediate-delete setting is confirmed again immediately before deletion, and original identity is unchanged. Other recycling failures never trigger permanent deletion. Dry-run cannot predict an ordinary item's bin-size outcome. Confirmed removal returns permanently_deleted; uncertain results return ambiguous and must not be resent. Completed bin moves return recycled, ordinary dry-runs return would_recycle, missing targets return already_absent, and failed/ambiguous items are not success. Set recursive=true for contents. Metadata and legacy recovery storage stay protected. Hard links retain shared content. Does not expand wildcards or follow link targets.

action.description: Omit for synchronous deletion. Enqueue accepts paths and recursive, never dryRun. Status/cancel require jobId only. Cancellation is allowed only while pending. On macOS the queue waits only for cooperating advisory flock holders; merely opening files or mapping dylibs does not delay deletion. Windows queue behavior remains based on Windows sharing and identity checks.

name: delete_registry
title: Back up and delete a registry key or value
description: Windows only; unsupported on macOS. Delete an explicitly authorized local HKCU/HKLM/HKU key or literal value in required view 32 or 64. Empty valueName selects the default value; omit for a key. Trees require recursive=true. Full Owner/Group/DACL/SACL backup requires SeSecurityPrivilege. No automatic elevation or nontransactional fallback. Host approvals and policies still apply.

accessMode.description: Choose backupRestore explicitly for this request; only view 64 in a 64-bit Windows process is supported. Never selected automatically.

name: restore_registry
title: Restore a registry deletion operation
description: Windows only; unsupported on macOS. Restore a retained registry operation in its recorded view. Refuse existing destinations including empty default values. Successful transaction consumes recovery data. Insufficient owner/SACL permissions or ambiguous commit preserve data without fallback.

name: reconcile_registry
title: Inspect a registry operation outcome
description: Windows only; unsupported on macOS. Read retained receipts after a disconnected native registry request. Does not repeat deletion or restore and does not infer unconfirmed transaction outcomes.

name: list_operations
title: List registry recovery operations
description: Windows only; unsupported on macOS. List retained registry operation ids. File and folder deletions have no Prunlet operation records.
